verdict.rationale: Sentry's own Trace Explorer supports ad hoc analysis, letting users explore span samples, visualize attributes and aggregate data with flexible queries and filters. The Issues page also supports property filters. Nothing in the evidence describes a formally documented query language or search syntax reference, so only the ad hoc analysis half of the story is shown. Missing for 10: documentation of a query language or search syntax (grammar, operators, functions), evidence that querying covers logs, errors and metrics as well as spans, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can analyze telemetry ad hoc with a documented query language

citations.quote: You can now explore span samples, visualize span attributes, and aggregate your data with flexible queries and filters.
This page allows you to filter by properties such as browser, device, impacted users, or whether an error is unhandled.
